title: Lesson 1 Quiz: Position Sizing and the Risk-Per-Trade Rule

questions.text: According to the risk-per-trade rule taught in this lesson, what is the maximum percentage of your account you should risk on a single trade if you follow the common professional guideline?
questions.explanation: The lesson states most professional traders use 2 percent as a maximum risk per trade.

questions.text: True or false: The risk-per-trade rule requires you to calculate the dollar amount you are willing to lose before determining your stop‑loss distance.
questions.explanation: The lesson outlines the sequence: risk percentage → risk amount → stop‑loss distance → position size.
